clips.title: The story
paras: At Splintertree Post, Locke Okarr needs supplies to keep the Warsong Lumber Camp running. Some await in town, some in Booty Bay, and others lie in enemy hands across Ashenvale.

Locke Okarr works to keep the Warsong Lumber Camp supplied from Splintertree Post. The Warsong Clan needs a steady flow of heavy tools to harvest Ashenvale's ancient timber. Raids by furbolgs and satyrs have scattered or seized local supplies, leaving the camp short of vital gear.

You gather equipment from across Kalimdor and beyond. Pixel, the goblin courier at Splintertree Post, has circular saw blades, while Wharfmaster Lozgil in Booty Bay holds a crate of heavy axes. Foulweald and Thistlefur furbolgs have taken logging ropes, and satyrs at Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian have stolen barrels of Warsong machinery oil for their profane rites.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We are in short supply of a few items at the Warsong lumber camp!
Pixel at Splintertree Post has our shipment of saw blades. It'll take a trip to Booty Bay to pick up a crate of axes from Wharfmaster Lozgil.

Our shipment of oil and rope will be more difficult. The rope was pilfered by the Thistlefur and Foulweald furbolgs, and the satyrs intercepted the delivery of the oil and are now using it for detestable rituals in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I hope you can come through with the supplies! I'm in big trouble if I don't deliver them soon!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent, friend. You've saved me a lot of work!
But don't think that I'm not grateful!
